lesson: Static weight cosine was a good first-pass clue: e.g. OV heads at layer 28 predicted weekday/month/ordinal transport with cosines 0.406/0.313/0.478, and layer 32 head 9 predicted comparatives at 0.361, but none of these passed causal tests.

High cosine did not imply a real causal circuit: layer 32 head 33 (roman_numeral, cosine 0.356) and layer 36 heads 0/3 (0.302/0.158) both had target drops only 0.002–0.0022, far below the 0.15 threshold.

The strongest real part in this run was the fraction-role MLP unit: layer 39 unit 11351 had numerator 0.246 and denominator 0.183, and the aligned down-column gave a huge 0.635 drop on fraction_role, but that sign was the wrong direction for the screen and the held-out check still failed.

Some MLP units clearly encoded lexical contrasts, not task skill: layer 35 unit 11748 pushed positive/positive variants down by about -0.45 to -0.50 and sign-like tokens up around 0.10, yet removing it changed product_sign by only 0.035.

Watch for broad, shared subword features and collateral effects: the month-number pair at layer 24 had cosine 0.211/0.198, but ablating it moved fraction_role by 0.089 and a control by 0.091, while target month_number itself shifted only 0.003.
